text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training with Yaeno Muteki,
we ran into Bamboo Memory out running.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be in a rush, Bamboo-san.
Are you heading out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm on patrol!
Apparently, there's a student running around the academy grounds past curfew lately!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
According to eyewitness accounts, it looks like
her body faintly glows white, sir.
That's pretty distinctive, so she should be easy to find!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thing is, it seems our opponent is seriously fast!
Word is they vanish into thin air in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Could that be some sort of specter
rather than a student?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Mononoke? Come to think of it, that's true..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All the more reason we can't just leave it alone, su! If everyone's too scared to come to school, the academy's in big trouble, su!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I agree.
When there are students who are still so young and innocent, if I don't protect them, who will...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I shall now go with Bamboo-san
to chase after the mononoke.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The conversation is going in a strange direction,
but at any rate, Yaeno Muteki seems completely pumped up to keep running.
choice_data_list: Go find out their true identity.
If we wait here, won't they pass by eventually?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Resuming patrols! Ghost or not,
I won't go easy on anyone disturbing public morals!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, running around the academy grounds
at night with Bamboo Memory turned out to be
great training for Yaeno Muteki as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, aside from the Umamusume named Agnes Tachyon,
no other suspicious persons were found, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, what keen insight. Indeed,
the culprit has been going around the school building, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm setting up a checkpoint right here, ss!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall accompany you. Should the culprit turn violent,
leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, no ghost appeared—there was only the
Umamusume named Agnes Tachyon—
but overworking was successfully avoided.
